normalization.title: Loudness normalization
normalization.offHint: Tracks play as they are in the files.
normalization.trackHint: Every track is levelled by its ReplayGain tag, so tracks of different albums sound equally loud. A track without the tag is levelled by its measured loudness (see Measure loudness) or plays as it is.
normalization.albumHint: Tracks are levelled by the ReplayGain of their album, which keeps the differences between the tracks of an album; a track without an album tag uses its own. A track without tags is levelled by its measured loudness (see Measure loudness) or plays as it is.
artistPhotos.title: Artist photos
artistPhotos.on: The photos of the artists come from Deezer. To find them, the names of the artists in your library are sent to Deezer. The photos are kept on this computer. They belong to Deezer and to their rights holders.
artistPhotos.off: The names of your artists are not sent anywhere. The photos that were downloaded stay.

radioSources.title: Radio and covers
radioSources.text: Stations come from radio-browser.info, a directory that anyone can add stations to; Tunelle does not run, check or endorse them. The stream and the logo of a station are loaded from the servers of the station. When a station gives no cover for the song it announces, the title of the song is sent to MusicBrainz to find one, and the Cover Art Archive serves it. The same happens when you search for the cover of an album: the text you typed is sent to MusicBrainz. Tunelle is not affiliated with radio-browser.info, Deezer or MusicBrainz. More: koeroesi86.github.io/tunelle/privacy.html
watchFolders.title: Watch library folders
watchFolders.on: Songs that are added to, changed in or removed from your library folders are picked up without a rescan. The folders are looked at every 10 seconds, and less often the longer a look takes, as on a big library or a network or removable drive, and when you come back to the window. A drive that is back is scanned.
watchFolders.off: The library folders are not watched or looked at while the app runs. Use Rescan to pick up changes; they are also looked for when the app starts and when a drive is back.
powerSaving.title: Save power
powerSaving.description: Saving power looks at your library folders and at a drive that is away four times less often, and measures the loudness of the song that plays only, the rest of the library waits for the charger. Playback is not changed.
measureLoudness.title: Measure loudness
measureLoudness.on: Tracks without ReplayGain tags are measured in the background, one at a time, while nothing plays, the computer is not on battery and the library has not been scanned for a while. What is measured levels the track like a tag would, and a tag always comes first. The first time takes a while on a big library.
measureLoudness.off: Tracks without ReplayGain tags play as they are. What was measured is kept.

about.restartPlaying: The playback stops for the restart. The queue and the position are kept.

notifyLibraryChanges.on: A notification tells you when a scan added, updated or removed songs, while the window is in the background. Clicking it shows the window.
notifyLibraryChanges.off: You are not told when a scan changes the library.
